sglang.note: glm5_next is not in sgl-project/sglang main as of 2026-08-28; the vendor image is built from a tarball and reports SGLANG_BUILD_COMMIT=unknown. Pinned by immutable digest only.

upstream_tracking.note: When #36507 merges, switch this build from vendor-image+digest to the sibling Qwen discipline: pin sglang main by commit AND tree, apply an archived patch, assert the effective tree hash. That restores real source provenance.

sm120_runtime_environment.rationale: GLM enters the shared DeepSeek/DSA hook but does not inherit the SM120 fallback block currently scoped to DeepseekV4ForCausalLM; v0.1.0-rc.4 reproduced a deep_gemm NameError during exact-hardware warmup.

sm120_mxfp4_runner_configuration.rationale: the SM120 post-loader configuration belongs to Mxfp4MoEMethod; the prior patch read layer.moe_runner_config and failed the vendor GPT-OSS GPU contract even though the GLM numerical path passed

sm120_sparse_mla_architecture.rationale: upstream #26928's dedicated SM120 FP8 sparse-MLA guard predates GLM-5.3 and rejects the native Glm5Next architecture name after target and MTP load

sm120_sparse_mla_glm_next_nope_kpool.rationale: v0.1.0-rc.9 proved target, native MTP, and 516,032-token pool allocation but its DSv4-specific 584-byte adapter branch was dead: exact vendor config and cache allocation show GLM-5.3 uses a 528-byte generic FP8 cache (512 E4M3 latent bytes plus four arbitrary FP32 scales) with no RoPE payload. The dedicated SM120 path must preserve all three live KPool tail entries after the 2,048-wide base table.
sm120_sparse_mla_glm_next_nope_kpool.qualification_status: exact-hardware numerical regressions passed on v0.1.0-rc.12; served-model output remained corrupt and the candidate was not qualified

kpool_unfused_transform.rationale: The v0.1.0-rc.11 unfused-KPool diagnostic reached the generic SGLang transform with GLM-5.3's exact 2,051-entry table and failed its hard-coded 2,048-entry assertion before inference. The correction preserves the existing tuned 2,048 decode path, admits only the exact GLM width, and retains all three live tail entries in decode and prefill.
kpool_unfused_transform.gpu_contract: decode and prefill outputs must exactly match the torch reference with base-table padding before live columns 2048..2050

norope_reserved_slot.rationale: v0.1.0-rc.12 target-only output remained corrupt after the 2,051-entry unfused transform passed. The production no-RoPE scatter was then reproduced writing physical slot 0 despite reserved_skip_index=0, while its positive-slot control succeeded. Aligning this branch with the ordinary MLA writer closes the concrete CUDA-graph padding corruption path.
norope_reserved_slot.fixed_contract: loc != reserved_skip_index and loc % DCP_WORLD_SIZE == DCP_RANK; valid locations are divided by DCP_WORLD_SIZE before scatter

sm120_tilelang_shared_memory.rationale: The independent TileLang BF16-KV DSA path is the only community-demonstrated GLM-5.3 no-RoPE backend on consumer Blackwell, but the vendor launch requests 169,984 bytes of dynamic shared memory on GPUs whose per-block limit is 101,376 bytes. The candidate narrows only SM120/SM121 to a 32-entry, one-stage, 128-thread launch; all non-SM12 CUDA and HIP paths remain unchanged.
sm120_tilelang_shared_memory.qualification_status: build-time contract only; exact-hardware numerical and served-output validation required

cpu_offload_tied_kda_parameters.rationale: The exact LibertAIDAI NVFP4 target loads all 121 shards with 20 GiB/rank CPU offload on the 2x94.97 GiB pair, then the first warmup fails because torch.func.functional_call sees separate copied values for GLM's intentionally tied KDA A_log and dt_bias aliases. Passing tie_weights=false is the PyTorch contract for that already-expanded state mapping.
cpu_offload_tied_kda_parameters.exact_control: LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 revision 357b45cc73a07a541cede88861f7736c9487ebf7, TP=2, flashinfer_cutlass, TileLang BF16 KV, 20 GiB/rank CPU offload

kda_padding_sentinel.rationale: The vendor GLM branch remaps padded -1 KDA rows to ssm_states.shape[0]-1, but MambaPool reserves slot zero and allocates the final slot to live requests. The chunk kernel already gates negative state indices, so preserve -1 exactly as SGLang main does.
kda_padding_sentinel.qualification_status: latent correctness fix from code audit; exact-hardware padded-batch validation required

kpool_topk_determinism.rationale: the exact vendor header is the pinned f14393b2 PR preimage and all four upstream GPU regressions fail on the exact v0.1.0-rc.5 image, including 100% mismatch in the coarse-bin-overflow case; the later PR head merges GLM support and adds HIP guards but does not change the NVIDIA kernel behavior or test blob

glm47_nested_tool_streaming.rationale: the exact vendor GLM47 parser emits malformed JSON when a nested object value ends in a brace and cannot resolve properties declared under top-level anyOf/oneOf/allOf; the upstream regression was reproduced in the pinned image

flashinfer.head: 93f4f2642e1b3680a52ebb51cf68e0fdad237796
flashinfer.install: exact non-editable source install with BUILD_NVEP=0 and FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0f; archived GLM_NEXT_NOPE patch applied with zero fuzz; sparse-MLA module NVCC-compiled at image build; generic flashinfer-cubin and flashinfer-jit-cache packages absent; FLASHINFER_NO_DOWNLOAD=1
flashinfer.rationale: the vendor wheel carries no 12.0f kernels and workstation Blackwell cannot run sm_100/Hopper kernels; refreshed main supports 656-byte V32/GLM-NSA and 584-byte DSv4 caches but not GLM-5.3's 528-byte no-RoPE cache. Changes since the prior pin do not touch sparse-MLA sources, and the isolated patch still applies with zero fuzz. It adds only the exact TP=2 GLM geometry and preserves existing dispatches.

speculative_decoding.baseline: native layer-45 MTP through SGLang EAGLE/NEXTN, fixed 5 steps / top-k 1 / 6 draft tokens
speculative_decoding.alternative: DFlash2 A/B candidate; no performance claim until measured on this exact rc

known_limitations: sglang #36596: is_layer_excluded misses fused module names and model.-prefixed names for mixed-precision checkpoints.
sglang #36550: CUDA-graph abort at first decode after cold prefill > 262144 tokens.
sglang #36669: thinking output degenerates into repeated '!' under multi-tool agentic prompts (native FP8, not a quantization artifact).
sglang #36711: flashinfer_trtllm MoE can produce an out-of-bounds expert index; this candidate pins flashinfer_mxfp4 instead.
sglang #36724: multimodal embedding isolation is under active repair; vision must be qualified explicitly.
Current DFlash2 draft-pool sizing charges draft KV at the target token-pool length, so DFlash2 may reduce maximum pooled context substantially versus native MTP until measured or fixed.
